name: Interior Design
title: Interior Design
intro: The interior design roadmap: entrances, four years of study, software, internships and practice.
glance: NID DAT, UCEED, CUET, institute tests

phases.title: Class 11–12 and early practice
phases.summary: Any stream; develop sketching, spatial sense and colour sense.
points: Interior design programmes accept Class 12 pass students from any stream.
Practise freehand sketching, perspective drawing and model making.
Observe homes, shops and public spaces and note design choices.
Learn basic geometry and measurement.

phases.title: Entrance exams
phases.summary: NID DAT, UCEED, CUET and institute tests.
points: NID DAT and UCEED assess visual thinking, drawing and problem-solving.
Several private institutes and universities run their own design aptitude tests and studio tests.
Prepare a portfolio and be ready for an interview.
Apply to multiple institutes because test dates differ.

phases.title: Design foundation
points: Learn drawing, colour, model making and design principles.
Study history of design and architecture.
Learn basic drafting and materials.
Take workshops in wood, metal and textile.

phases.title: Interior design studios and software
phases.summary: Space planning, lighting, furniture and 3D visualisation.
points: Learn space planning, lighting design, furniture design and building services.
Learn AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit and rendering tools.
Study materials, costing and building codes.
Complete studio projects for homes, offices and retail.

phases.title: Internships and career
phases.summary: Training in firms and your own practice.
points: Intern with interior design firms and architecture studios, and visit sites.
Present a final-year thesis project.
Work as junior designer, site supervisor or visualiser.
Start your own studio after building client experience; further study includes M.Des.
